Ordinance No. 2026-10 Adopted 7/14/26 AN ORDINANCE OF THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF ALACHUA COUNTY FLORIDA AMENDING THE ALACHUA COUNTY CODE OF ORDINANCES, TITLE 40, RELATING TO THE REGULATION OF THE USE AND DEVELOPMENT OF LAND IN THE UNINCORPORATED AREA OF ALACHUA COUNTY, FLORIDA; INCLUDING AMENDMENTS RELATED TO CHAPTER 402 ARTICLE XIX TRADITIONAL NEIGHBORHOOD AND TRANSIT ORIENTED DEVELOPMENT APPLICATIONS, AND CHAPTER 407 ARTICLE VII TRADITIONAL NEIGHBORHOOD AND TRANSIT ORIENTED DEVELOPMENTS; PROVIDING FOR MODIFICATIONS; A REPEALING CLAUSE; SEVERABILITY; INCLUSION IN THE CODE AND CORRECTION OF SCRIVENER'S ERRORS; LIBERAL CONSTRUCTION; AND PROVIDING AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

Ordinance No. 2026-09 Adopted 7/14/26 AN ORDINANCE OF THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF ALACHUA COUNTY FLORIDA AMENDING THE ALACHUA COUNTY CODE OF ORDINANCES, TITLE 40, RELATING TO THE REGULATION OF THE USE AND DEVELOPMENT OF LAND IN THE UNINCORPORATED AREA OF ALACHUA COUNTY, FLORIDA; INCLUDING AMENDMENTS TO CHAPTER 407 GENERAL DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS; AND AMENDING ALACHUA COUNTY CODE, CHAPTER 51 ENTITLED "VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC"; PROVIDING FOR MODIFICATIONS; A REPEALING CLAUSE; SEVERABILITY; INCLUSION IN THE CODE AND CORRECTION OF SCRIVENER'S ERRORS; LIBERAL CONSTRUCTION; PROVIDING AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

Ordinance No. 2026-04 Adopted 4/14/26 AN ORDINANCE OF THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF ALACHUA COUNTY, FLORIDA, AMENDING THE ALACHUA COUNTY CODE OF ORDINANCES, PART II, TITLE 2, CHAPTER 23 ON PERSONNEL, ARTICLE III ENTITLED "WHISTLE-BLOWER PROVISIONS;" AMENDING ARTICLE III TO CLARIFY AND EXPLICITLY PROVIDE THAT VOLUNTEERS ARE PROTECTED BY THE ORDINANCE; PROVIDING FOR MODIFICATION; PROVIDING FOR ORDINANCE TO BE LIBERALLY CONSTRUED; PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY; PROVIDING FOR INCLUSION IN THE CODE; AND PROVIDING FOR AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

Ordinance No. 2026-01 Adopted 1/13/26 AN ORDINANCE OF THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF ALACHUA COUNTY, FLORIDA, AMENDING THE ALACHUA COUNTY CODE OF ORDINANCES, PART II, TITLE 2, CHAPTER 22 ENTITED “ALACHUA COUNTY PROCUREMENT CODE”; AMENDING COMPETITIVE PROCUREMENT THRESHOLDS; AMENDING THE COUNTY MANAGER’S APPROVAL AND SIGNATURE AUTHORITY THRESHOLDS; AMENDING THE SMALL BUSINESS ENTERPRISE PROGRAM; ADOPTING A LOCAL PREFERENCE PROGRAM; SUNSETTING THE GOVERNMENT MINIMUM WAGE REQUIREMENT; AUTHORIZING THE COUNTY MANAGER TO APPROVE CONTRACT RENEWALS; AMENDING THE REPORTING THRESHOLDS FOR UNAUTHORIZES PURCHASES; PROVIDING FOR MODIFICATION; PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY; PROVIDING FOR INCLUSION IN THE CODE; AND PROVIDING FOR AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

Ordinance No. 2025-07 Adopted 4/22/25 AN ORDINANCE OF THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF ALACHUA COUNTY, FLORIDA, AMENDING CHAPTER 29 OF THE ALACHUA COUNTY CODE OF ORDINANCES; PROVIDING FOR A TITLE AND PURPOSE; PROVIDING FOR DEFINITIONS; PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A COUNTY ARTS PROGRAM CITIZEN ADVISORY COMMITTEE; PROVIDING FOR A SPECIAL REVENUE FUND; PROVIDING FOR AN ART SELECTION PROCEDURE; PROVIDING FOR OWNERSHIP AND MAINTENANCE; PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY; PROVIDING FOR MODIFICATION; PROVIDING FOR A REPEALING CLAUSE; PROVIDING FOR INCLUSION IN THE CODE; PROVIDING FOR AN EFFECTIVE DATE.
